description: Fix remote live preview/control inside the Agent: loopback viewer links are now rewritten to the funnel /live/ route on every iframe, probe, reload and fullscreen open (token/scale/view_only preserved, control vs preview tokens unchanged), so the floating preview no longer shows 127.0.0.1 refused to connect.
features: remoteLiveUrl() now defaults to the current page location, so all single-arg callers rewrite remotely and keep local pages untouched.
Probes, reloads, revive-frames and fullscreen opens use the rewritten /live/ URL (no more localhost checks from the viewer's machine).
Preview idempotency compares the rewritten src (no reopen flicker).
Version synced to 0.14.1 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
